title: Window & Door Screen Repair
subtitle: Deposits · Wait Time · What to Bring

blocks.html: Deposit to start — $5 per window, $10 per door. Applied toward your final repair cost.
Current wait — about 4 weeks. Repairs are backlogged; your screen joins the queue the day you drop it off.

items: Bring it in. Pay your deposit and join the queue.
We repair it. Our team evaluates & fixes your screen.
We call you. Pick up when it’s ready.

blocks.html: Final price is set after our team sees your screen and evaluates parts & labor. Want a number first? Ask for a quote before repairs begin — no obligation.

items: Standard re-screening — All four sides and corners must be intact.
Frame repair — Bring at least one side of each length plus a corner bracket, so the team can identify the parts needed.
Frame repair: 2015 or newer only — Parts for older frames are too difficult to source, so we can’t repair them.
We don’t repair Andersen — Andersen windows & doors must go back to the manufacturer.

blocks.heading: Questions about your repair? Ask for Karen K.
